thread:
kai (Design): quick check  compact bulk-remove mock: https://go.mock/redwood/bulk-compact. Qs: inline row errors vs single top alert, asterisk vs explicit 'Required', and typed confirm for bulk deletes. thoughts?
lee (PM): inline errors for paste flow so folks can fix quickly. top alert only for counts + jump link.
sam (Eng): typed confirm OK for larger batches but watch mobile keyboard. debounce paste, disable CTA until exact match, and always server-verify before commit.
anya (A11y): asterisk alone is not enough  include sr-only "required" or visible label for compliance fields. error summary must be role="alert" and focusable; announce step changes with aria-live. avoid color-only cues.
ops-bot: telemetry: emit bulk_open, bulk_row_error_shown, bulk_row_error_fixed, bulk_confirm_attempt, bulk_confirm_success, bulk_undo_used (include org_id, user_role, device).
lee (PM): decision proposal: default = inline errors + top summary; typed confirm threshold = 10 (org-configurable); undo window = 3m default. run 8-week A/B test measuring accidental_removal_rate + time_to_complete.
kai (Design): thanks  i'll update mocks and microcopy, add A/B variants, and schedule a 20m follow-up.
